[[File:PalpatinesChair.png|thumb|right|200px|The Chair of Office]]
The '''Chair of Office''' was the chair of the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], located in the [[Chancellor's Suite/Legends|Chancellor's office]] in the [[Republic Executive Building/Legends|Republic Executive Building]].

Chancellor [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] Chair of Office afforded its owner a high level of security. The chair was sheathed in ultra-dense [[Lanthanide/Legends|lanthanide]] alloy [[Armor/Legends|armor]], and was equipped with a defensive [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generator]]. A [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] built into the armrest allowed Palpatine direct communications with his [[Aide/Legends|aides]] and members of the [[Red Guard]]. The chair was positioned behind the Chancellor's desk, which was equipped with data feeds from his private office and holding office in the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]]. The private office contained three similar chairs with built-in communications devices. The chair used to restrain Palpatine during the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]] inside the [[General's quarters]] on the [[Invisible Hand/Legends|''Invisible Hand'']] featured a similar design to the Chair of Office.

[[File:PalpatineRedGuard-TWJ.png|thumb|left|Palpatine's chair in the Military Tribunal Courtroom.]]
A replica of the chair was placed in the courtroom of the [[Republic military base]]
for the Chancellor's use during trials.

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], after Palpatine [[Declaration of a New Order|declared]] himself [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]], he kept a [[Imperial throne|throne]] in his [[Emperor's throne room|throne room]] aboard the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]] that echoed the style of his Chair of Office. This, too, contained a personal shield, and a comlink and [[Emperor's Royal Guard/Legends|Royal Guard]]-summoner.
